title: Castling and the rules of play

bank.prompt: The squares are clear and nothing is attacked, but White may not castle. Why?
options: The king has moved earlier in the game
The rook has to jump over the king
There are pawns on the second row

bank.prompt: White may castle on the long side but not on the short side. Why?
options: The rook on h1 has already moved
f1 and g1 are occupied
The king is in check

bank.prompt: White would like to castle on the long side. What stops him?
options: The queen is still on d1
The rook on a1 has moved
The king would land on an attacked square

bank.prompt: Both pieces are at home and f1 and g1 are empty. What stops White castling?
options: The king would land on g1, which the rook on g8 attacks
The king has already moved
A king may not castle towards an enemy king
